description: Database intelligence graph mapping all GII GeM ERP tables, columns, relationships, service modules, posting functions, report sources, audit trails, and accounting protection boundaries.

dependencies.description: Knowledge graph entries reference database tables via tableRef fields
Workflow graph nodes correspond to database tables in the government supply lifecycle

tables.title: Schema Migrations
tables.notes: Internal migration tracking table. Not exposed via generic CRUD.

tables.title: Users
tables.notes: Authentication and authorization. Managed by authService.

tables.title: Companies
tables.notes: Multi-company context. Every transaction record references company_id. Managed by safeDeleteService.

tables.title: Employees
tables.notes: Employee master. Referenced by supply_orders and expense entries for incentive calculation.

tables.title: Government Departments
tables.notes: Government department/customer master. Referenced by supply_orders, receivables, invoices.

tables.title: Suppliers
tables.notes: Supplier/vendor master. Referenced by procurements, supplier_payments.

tables.title: Items / Products
tables.notes: Item/product master. Core master table referenced by order_items, invoice_items, procurement_items, stock transactions.

tables.title: Expense Heads
tables.notes: Expense head master. Used by expense_entries for order-level expense tracking.

tables.title: Bank Accounts
tables.notes: Bank account master. Referenced by payments, supplier_payments, cash_bank_ledger.

tables.title: Work Order / Supply Order
tables.notes: Database representation of WG-1 WORK_ORDER operational root. Central operational entity. Does not post accounting entries by itself.
knownGaps: Gem order fields (gem_order_number, gem_contract_number) require GeM API integration.

tables.title: Procurements / Supplier Purchase Orders
tables.notes: Supplier procurement record. Posting generates Purchase voucher (Dr Purchase, Dr Input GST, Cr Trade Payables).

tables.title: Expense Entries
tables.notes: Order-level expense tracking. Posting creates Journal voucher via postExpenseAccrualsForOrder.

tables.title: Sales Invoices / GST Invoices
tables.notes: Sales/GST invoice. Posting via postSalesVoucher creates Sales voucher (Dr Trade Receivables, Cr Sales, Cr Output GST). Source for receivables.

tables.title: Receipts / Payments from Departments
tables.notes: Department receipt records. Posting via postReceiptVoucher creates Receipt voucher (Dr Cash/Bank, Cr Trade Receivables).

tables.title: Order Line Items
tables.notes: Line items for supply orders. Cascade-deleted with parent order.

tables.title: Procurement Line Items
tables.notes: Line items for procurements. Used in purchase posting calculations.

tables.title: Invoice Line Items
tables.notes: Line items for invoices. Used in sales posting calculations (taxable, CGST, SGST, IGST per line).

tables.title: Department Receivables
tables.notes: Receivables subledger. Created by upsertReceivable during sales posting. Updated by refreshReceivable during receipt allocation. Not a GL table â€” tracks outstanding against Trade Receivables control account.

tables.title: Receipt Payment Allocations
tables.notes: Links receipt payments to invoices. Tracks TDS, GST TDS deductions per allocation. Soft-deleted and replaced on reallocation.

tables.title: Supplier Payments
tables.notes: Supplier payment records. Posting via postSupplierPaymentVoucher creates Payment voucher (Dr Trade Payables, Cr Cash/Bank).

tables.title: Supplier Payment Allocations
tables.notes: Links supplier payments to procurements. Tracks allocation amounts.

tables.title: Chart of Accounts
tables.notes: Core chart of accounts. Referenced by every voucher_line and ledger_entry. Parent_account_id enables hierarchical account grouping.

tables.title: Vouchers
tables.notes: Central accounting voucher table. Created by all posting functions. Never generic CRUD-writable. Voucher lines hold actual debit/credit entries.

tables.title: Voucher Lines
tables.notes: Individual debit/credit lines for each voucher. Double-entry accounting is enforced at application level.

tables.title: Ledger Entries
tables.notes: General ledger entries - the system of record for all accounting transactions. Never directly written from UI.

tables.title: Cash and Bank Ledger
tables.notes: Cash/bank sub-ledger tracking all cash and bank transactions separately from the general ledger.

tables.title: Audit Log
tables.notes: Central audit trail. Every create/update/delete/posting/reversal action writes to this table.

tables.title: Documents
tables.notes: Document/file storage table. Supports linked_module/linked_record_id polymorphic association pattern.

tables.title: Import Batches
tables.notes: Tracks bulk import operations. id is TEXT (UUID) for distributed uniqueness.

tables.title: Feedback Log
tables.notes: User feedback collection table. Managed by feedbackService.

tables.title: Warehouses
tables.notes: Warehouse master. Referenced by all stock transaction tables and items.default_warehouse_id.

tables.title: Stock Inwards / Goods Receipt
tables.notes: Stock inward records. Posting updates stock_ledger, inventory_movements, serial_numbers and batches.

tables.title: Stock Outwards / Issue
tables.notes: Stock outward records. Posting creates stock_ledger entries and optionally a Journal voucher for COGS.

tables.title: Stock Ledger
tables.notes: Inventory valuation ledger. Every stock transaction writes here. Never directly written from UI.

tables.title: Serial Numbers
tables.notes: Serial number tracking for items with track_serial_number enabled.

tables.title: Batches
tables.notes: Batch/lot tracking for items with track_batch_number enabled.

tables.title: Stock Adjustments
tables.notes: Stock adjustment records for physical count corrections, damage, etc.

tables.title: Stock Returns
tables.notes: Stock returns from departments or to suppliers.

tables.title: Stock Reservations
tables.notes: Inventory reservation system. Ensures stock availability before delivery challan generation.

tables.title: Inventory Movements
tables.notes: Audit trail for all inventory movements between warehouses and transaction types.

tables.title: Bank Statement Imports
tables.notes: Tracks imported bank statement files. Also has valid_rows, duplicate_rows, error_rows, and review/approval columns.

tables.title: Bank Statement Entries
tables.notes: Individual bank statement lines. Also has many additional reference fields for matching (order_id, billing_id, etc.).

tables.title: Bank Reconciliation Matches
tables.notes: Stores suggested auto-matches between bank entries and ERP records.

tables.title: Voucher Proposals (Auto-Generated)
tables.notes: Auto-generated voucher proposals from bank statement matching. One per bank entry.

tables.title: Voucher Proposal Audit
tables.notes: Audit trail for voucher proposal lifecycle (approve/reject/modify).

tables.title: Financial Years
tables.notes: Financial year definition. Controls whether transactions can be posted in a given period.

tables.title: Opening Balances
tables.notes: Opening balance records loaded at financial year start via createOpeningBalance posting function.

tables.title: Approval Queue
tables.notes: Generic approval queue supporting maker-checker workflow for any module.

tables.title: Year End Closings
tables.notes: Year-end closing records capturing trial balance, balance sheet differences, and net profit.

tables.title: Carry Forward Entries
tables.notes: Carries forward closing balances from one FY to the next as opening balances.

tables.title: Advance Adjustments
tables.notes: Tracks advance adjustments applied to invoices (receipt side) or procurements (supplier side).

tables.title: Credit Terms
tables.notes: Credit term definitions per department or supplier. Used in receivable/payable ageing calculations.

tables.title: Advance Receipts (Department)
tables.notes: Tracks advance payments received from government departments before invoicing.

tables.title: Supplier Advances
tables.notes: Tracks advance payments made to suppliers before procurement completion.

tables.title: Allocation Audit
tables.notes: Audit trail for payment allocation and reallocation events.

tables.title: Guided Vouchers
tables.notes: Guided voucher payload storage for automated inventory/accounting posting. Supports multi-step approval flow.

tables.title: Goods Receipt Notes (GRN)
tables.notes: Goods Receipt Note created automatically when guided voucher posts purchase + stock inward.

tables.title: GRN Line Items
tables.notes: Line items for GRN. Links to stock_inwards via stock_inward_id.

tables.title: Delivery Challans
tables.notes: Delivery challan records. Confirmation triggers stock_outwards creation and posting.

tables.title: Delivery Challan Items
tables.notes: Line items for delivery challans.

tables.title: Warehouse Transfers
tables.notes: Warehouse-to-warehouse stock transfers. Posting updates stock_ledger and creates inventory_movements.

tables.title: Import Batch Records
tables.notes: Records created by each import batch, enabling rollback capability.

tables.title: CRAC Records
tables.notes: CRAC (Consolidated Receipt and Acceptance Certificate) records for government supply closure.

tables.title: Leads / Tenders
tables.notes: Optional pre-order lead and tender stage. Generic CRUD is company-scoped and audited.

tables.title: Requirement Queries
tables.notes: Optional requirement clarification stage linked to a lead.
knownGaps: Lead selection uses a numeric reference until a dedicated picker is added.

tables.title: Quotations
tables.notes: Commercial quotation stage. It does not post accounting entries.
knownGaps: Requirement Query selection uses a numeric reference until a dedicated picker is added.

tables.title: Negotiations
tables.notes: Commercial negotiation stage. Savings are operational metrics only.
knownGaps: Quotation selection uses a numeric reference until a dedicated picker is added.

tables.title: Purchase Orders / GeM Orders

columns.name: employee_id
columns.description: Responsible employee for Work Order conversion

tables.notes: Operational Purchase Order root before Work Order. Controlled conversion is atomic and audit logged.
knownGaps: Converted Work Orders begin in Draft and require item completion in the Work Order screen.

tables.title: Procurement Plans
tables.notes: Operational planning table. Stock availability, shortage, and estimated value are backend-derived.

tables.title: Installations
tables.notes: Optional delivery-stage installation tracking. Document evidence remains in the document workflow.

accountingProtectionMappings.reason: Contains posted accounting entries - never generic CRUD writable
Double-entry data integrity - only created by posting functions
System of record for all accounting transactions
Cash/bank balance integrity - only updated by posting functions
Department outstanding tracking - updated via upsert/refresh functions
Receipt allocation integrity - only created by postReceiptVoucher
Inventory valuation integrity - only updated by stock posting functions
Chart of accounts - hierarchical integrity must be preserved
FY open/close/lock state controls posting permissions
Opening balances must match verified carry-forward

knownGaps.description: WG-1 workflow graph not fully aligned - guided_vouchers, advance_receipts, supplier_advances, advance_adjustments, credit_terms, allocation_audit not yet mapped to workflow stages
Migration 002 missing - some schema changes applied without explicit migration version
CASCADE behavior documented only for key relationships - most FK cascade is application-managed
GST impact flags set only for sales/purchase posting - inventory posting GST impact not fully analyzed
Column-level audit granularity not yet tracked - audit_log captures old/new JSON but column details not structured

compatibilityNotes.schemaVersionCompatibility: 1.0.0 allows additive changes (new tables, new columns). Breaking changes require Major version bump.
compatibilityNotes.kg1Integration: KG-1 tableRef fields reference database-graph.json table IDs
compatibilityNotes.wg1Integration: WG-1 workflow stages are mapped to database tables via relatedWorkflowStage field
compatibilityNotes.accountingBaseline: Double-entry accounting engine is the protected baseline â€” no generic CRUD on accounting core tables

risk.partialFKMetadata: Foreign key metadata is partially embedded in application code rather than declared in schema â€” manual mapping may have gaps
risk.columnTypeMismatch: Some columns use TEXT for date values â€” column type consistency is a known technical debt area
